items.text: While many pharmacies already provide information to patients about their prescriptions, some rural communities and seniors are left without vital instructions, especially in communities without reliable broadband. (2/3)

I joined the Healthy Future Task Force to ensure patients, no matter their economic status, can easily access affordable, safe treatments. 

For too long, bureaucracy has gotten in the way of common-sense solutions that put patients first.
https://t.co/yeo0zZZ2E6

Today, I introduced a comprehensive health care reform plan that combines over 75 bipartisan proposals to:
✅Lower health care costs
✅Increase the number of insured Americans
✅Protect those with preexisting conditions
✅Expand coverage options (1/3)
https://t.co/j5atDvAb8y

The Fair Care Act is all about putting families' hard earned tax $$$ back into their pockets so they can make their own choices about their health care coverage.

I am confident that through the Fair Care Act, affordable health care is possible for every American. 3/3

QALYs are a flawed measure used to put a dollar value on the lives of patients to determine if a treatment is cost-effective or not. I believe you can't put a price on human life, so I proudly voted YES on HR 485 to prohibit the use of QALYs and affirm that every life has value.

The Biden Admin's recent guidance on the Emergency Medical Treatment and Active Labor Act was not made with the best interests of mothers in mind and rather is a political loophole to allow more abortions.

Read about the brief I cosigned, led by @RepRussFulcher, to stop this federal overreach⤵️

Learn more about the FY25 Military Construction, Veterans Affairs, and Related Agencies Appropriations Act here: https://t.co/cubhD2ddTV

I’m proud to represent a district that leads the nation in forestry and forest products, providing jobs to over 11,000 Arkansans in our district alone. #ForestProductsWeek shines the light on an industry that sources everything from toilet paper to medical supplies for people all around the world. As the only licensed forester in Congress, I am committed to developing common sense solutions that boost forest management in order to promote healthy forests and forest product markets.

If not, TRIWest will miss obtaining Jan. payment resulting in a health insurance coverage lapse. https://t.co/lCh4ruo1Ij

🚨I just introduced The Fair Care Act of 2024, a commonsense healthcare bill designed to:

→ cover preexisting conditions
→ lower insurance & prescription drug costs
→ increase coverage choices
→ promote telehealth

The Fair Care Act of 2024 is a healthcare bill for every American, and I look forward to seeing this bill move through the legislative process.

🚨PASSED!
The House just passed my bill, the Fix our Forests Act, that I proudly cosponsored with @RepScottPeters, to restore forest health, increase resiliency to catastrophic wildfires, and protect communities located dangerously close to wildland urban interfaces. Now, it heads to the Senate, where I look forward to seeing a swift, bipartisan passage.
